summary_text: On this weekend, the user purchased one unit of Colin Glass and Surface Cleaner Liquid Refill (1 L) during the morning. This timing aligns with the population baseline, where morning purchases (32.46%) are the most common daypart share, slightly higher than afternoon (25.26%) and evening (30.27%). The product is a household cleaning refill intended for regular maintenance of glass and multi-surfaces. This is a single observation on one date. It is not yet established whether this represents a stable brand preference for Colin, a routine for this specific product, or a one-time restock need. No other orders in this window support a durable preference claim.
